purpose: Reopen only the least-compounded AutoRound E5M2 KV question on the materially newer immutable f01e runtime: TP1, MTP0, explicit eager execution, engine init, then an exact 128-token canary. Only a passing canary triggers the complete frozen quality battery in the same server lifetime.

prior_evidence.cell: TP1/MTP0/eager/fp8_e5m2 (and all four attempted E5M2 arms)
prior_evidence.exact_error: NotImplementedError: FlashAttention does not support fp8_e5m2 kv-cache on this device

reopen_basis: The official f01e image is a different immutable source/runtime family (vLLM 0.27.2rc1.dev77 at ac7509e2b) from the e9d image (0.26.1rc1.dev1102 at e9d1398d9) that explicitly rejected E5M2 KV on XPU. That change permits this one init/canary sentinel only.

quality_contract.full_pass: seven exact cases, eight-repeat one-hash determinism, 8K needle, 24 baseline comparisons, and cache zero
quality_contract.gate: The full battery runs only after the exact canary passes. Any nonzero quality result closes the sentinel as canary-passed-quality-failed and authorizes no descendants.

terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an explicit exact-image log line naming E5M2 KV cache and unsupported/invalid semantics qualifies.
terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-sentinel: Engine init, exact canary, full quality, and cleanup all pass; only a separately preregistered descendant may expand coverage.
terminal_classification.canary-passed-quality-failed: Engine init and exact canary pass but the full quality battery fails; preserve evidence and keep descendants closed.
terminal_classification.failed: Generic timeout/startup failure, identity mismatch, canary failure, cleanup failure, or any other non-explicit failure.
